summary.name: NaturalReader
summary.one_liner: NaturalReader is an AI text-to-speech service that turns documents, web pages, PDFs and scanned books into natural-sounding audio for reading, accessibility, voiceovers and education.
use_cases: listen to PDFs, ebooks and web pages on the go
create voiceovers for videos, ads and eLearning
make textbooks and readings accessible for students
turn long documents into podcast-style episodes
study with summaries and practice quizzes
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a browser-based and mobile text-to-speech reader that converts text, PDFs, Word docs, ePub, web pages and scanned physical books into AI-generated audio. Users can customize voice delivery, tone, emotion and accent with text prompts, or choose from ready-made voice styles. Built-in AI features include generating podcast-style episodes, summaries, screenshot analysis, document Q&A with translation, and practice quizzes. Audio can be exported to MP3, and an EDU offering provides group or site licenses with classroom management and accessibility features such as closed captions, dyslexia font and hotkeys.
notable: Voice design via text prompts to set tone, emotion and accent
Camera scanner to read physical books and documents aloud
Export audio to MP3 for offline listening
EDU group and site licenses with classroom management
caveats: Commercial and advanced features are described under paid plans; exact prices are not shown on the page
Discounted EDU pricing requires group or site licenses
Some AI features and HD voices are tied to paid tiers in the page's plan descriptions
